description: Connect to the HenryKnows page the person is watching (its light turns green) and get the session for share_to_page. Only for people who gave you a session code or asked to follow along on a page. Side effects: creates a session, or links the one the person gave, and returns that session and the page's watch link; a new session starts each time it is called without a code; nothing is deleted.

session.description: The session code the person gave you (from their HenryKnows page). Omit to start a new session and get a new watch link.

name: connect
title: Connect to a HenryKnows page
